source: Hand-authored micro-sequences of 2 to 11 trades each (the fake cube serves them as profile micro:<name>). The trades are invented, not market history; nothing here was recorded or generated from a seed.
notes: Every `expected` block was derived on paper from the trade list and the stated rules (base column = 56,250 ms, base row = 12,500 cents, notional = price * qty / 1e10, the fake's own motion semantics of TESTPLAN 4.5); the derivation is in expected.notes of each file. The blocks are then checked against the exact-rational reference calculator (tests/unit/reference.test.js), and only after that used to check the fake cube (tests/unit/fake-vs-reference.test.js). One slip of the hand derivation (a dwell interval of the `paths` fixture that crosses a column edge, two cells) was found by that check and corrected on paper after re-deriving the split, not by copying the calculator's output. Shape of a file (DR-45): {trades:[{t_ms, price, qty, takerBuy, count?}], gaps:[[t0_ms, t1_ms]], cutoffIso, expected}. The fake ignores `expected`; its keys are: notes (the derivation in words); rect {b0, cellsB1, motionB1, cutMs} = the first base column, the end of a cells read (the cutoff's ceiling, the open column included), the end of a motion or bars read (the cutoff's floor) and the cutoff in ms since 2021-01-01T00:00:00Z; cells {"n:m": [{c, r, v, bv, ct, bt, d}]} with d = 2 bv - v (Delta); motion {"n:m": [{c, r, p, w, hi, lo, v, bv, ct, bt}]} with p in USDT, w in seconds and "NaN" for high/low of a cell without trades; bars {"n": [{col, open, high, low, close, volume, takerBuyVolume, baseVolume, trades}]}; summary [{rect: {b0, b1, m}, volume, takerBuyVolume, trades, takerBuyTrades, pocRow, poc, takerBuyPocRow, takerBuyPoc}]; periodRows [{b0, b1, m, rows: [{r, v, bv, ct, bt}]}] (relvol); columnDwell {col: seconds} (gaps). Times are ms since the epoch, prices 1e-2 USDT, quantities 1e-8 BTC, rows are base rows of 125 USDT.
